mapper.sql: g.id, g.author_id, g.title, g.content, g.category, g.cover_image, g.view_count, g.like_count, g.comment_count, g.is_featured, g.status, g.created_at, g.updated_at
, u.username AS author_name , u.avatar AS author_avatar
LEFT JOIN t_user u ON g.author_id = u.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_rental_guide (author_id, title, content, category, cover_image, view_count, like_count, comment_count, is_featured, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{coverImage}, 0, 0, 0, 0, COALESCE(#{status}, 'published'), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_rental_guide SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_rental_guide SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_rental_guide SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
